source_of_truth: coreboot-25.12 local tree (sha256 486a737f… tarball) — src/mainboard listing
criteria: port_in_tree — a Kconfig-selectable mainboard in the release we built
platform_alignment — does the board share the study's lens (AMD/PSP/AGESA, cf. TWIN-1 day-0)?
containment — Boot Guard era, ME/PSP neutralizability, no fused vendor key
flash_logistics — SOIC8/SOIC16 clip reachability, chip size, CH341A compatibility
maturity — age of the port, known S3/memory-training quirks (to verify on board-status)
availability_price — TO VERIFY at purchase (no shopping data in this study)

candidates.platform_alignment: AMD/AGESA — SAME platform family as the TWIN-1 study (PSP lens applies)
candidates.containment: AMD platform — PSP signs AGESA; no Intel Boot Guard/FPF; ME question does not exist
candidates.flash_logistics: to verify (Framework publishes board repair docs; CH341A clip reachability at purchase)
candidates.maturity: in official tree + Dasharo offering; per-board quirks to verify
candidates.verdict: PRIMARY CANDIDATE — the study's AMD knowledge transfers directly

candidates.tree_path: framework/ (azalea only — Intel Framework NOT in coreboot 25.12 tree)
candidates.platform_alignment: Intel — off the study's AMD lens
candidates.containment: Intel Boot Guard state to check per unit (Dasharo documents unlocked states)
candidates.verdict: SECONDARY — Dasharo official path (doctrine's original 'smoothest'), but platform-divergent and not in the 25.12 tree

candidates.tree_path: system76/ (11 model dirs: addw1, adl, bonw14, gaze15, kbl-u, mtl, oryp5, oryp6, rpl, tgl-h, tgl-u, whl-u)
candidates.platform_alignment: mixed Intel generations — off the AMD lens
candidates.containment: coreboot ships from factory + open EC — the zero-boarding-risk lane
candidates.verdict: SECONDARY — factory-coreboot lane, no flash ceremony needed, but no before/after experiment on one's own board

candidates.platform_alignment: Intel Ivy Bridge — the classic school; me_cleaner-able
candidates.containment: pre-Boot Guard era (fusing started Haswell+) — containment trivial
candidates.maturity: the most-documented coreboot port in existence
candidates.verdict: THE SCHOOL — maximal maturity and containment; hardware is 2012-old (DDR3), price minimal

candidates.tree_path: lenovo/ — t440p ABSENT from 25.12 Kconfig.name (was historically supported)
candidates.verdict: DEMOTED — doctrine listed it, but the port is not in the 25.12 tree; verify board-status history before ever buying
candidates.honesty: absence in tree is evidence of the release's supported set, not of history — re-check if considered

candidates.tree_path: asus/ — zero AM4 boards in 25.12 (p2b, p5q*, h61-series, maximus_iv_gene-z, p8x7x-series, h610i-plus-d4)
candidates.platform_alignment: AMD AM4 — the study's control group
candidates.containment: n/a — the rule that does not bend: the guard fleet is never flashed
candidates.verdict: CONTROL GROUP ONLY — confirms the doctrine's 'no port' and the Volume-5 decision (the sacrificial bench is a second used B450, not a port); +0 octet forever

candidates.machine: ASRock Rack X470D4U (AM4, the research README's lane B)
candidates.tree_path: zero hits for x470d4u across src/ and Documentation/ of 25.12 (asrock/ holds 21 Intel-era boards + h110m, imb-1222, spc741d8)
candidates.platform_alignment: AMD AM4 — would have been the aligned lane
candidates.verdict: ABSENT FROM 25.12 — the remembered port does not exist in the release we built; pursuing it means pinning an older coreboot or a fork, a maintenance cost the lane decision must own
candidates.honesty: same evidence class as the T440p demotion — absence in tree is evidence of the release's supported set, not of history

candidates.platform_alignment: Intel Alder Lake-N/R — off the AMD lens, but a consumer ASUS with an in-tree port
candidates.verdict: RESEARCH LANE — proves consumer-ASUS coreboot exists; maturity and Boot Guard state to verify before ranking

recommendation: coreboot-capable lane (separate question from the Volume-5 B450 bench): primary = Framework 13 AMD 7040 azalea (platform alignment with the study's AMD/PSP lens, in-tree, Dasharo lane); fallback = x230 for maximal maturity/containment at minimal cost; System76 if the before/after experiment matters less than a guaranteed-open machine. The two AM4 refutations (B450-PLUS, X470D4U absent from 25.12) close the 'coreboot on our audited platform' shortcut
honesty: checked against the 25.12 tree only — port age, S3 quality and memory-training quirks need board-status data at purchase time
price/availability deliberately left as to-verify — this study does not shop
the doctrine's candidate table (lab/coreboot-notes.md) predates this matrix; azalea's AMD identity and both AM4 absences are new evidence
